version.title: Version
version.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.4. The server runs Mojang's own server jar for it.

motd.title: Message of the day
motd.description: The line players see under the server's name in their server list.

max-players.title: Player limit
max-players.description: How many players can be online at once.

gamemode.title: Game mode
gamemode.description: The mode new players join in.

force-gamemode.title: Force game mode
force-gamemode.description: Players join in the game mode above every time, not the one they left in.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.description: How hard the world is. Peaceful has no hostile mobs.

hardcore.title: Hardcore
hardcore.description: Players who die are made spectators, and the difficulty stays hard.

white-list.title: Whitelist
white-list.description: Only players on the whitelist can join.

online-mode.title: Check accounts with Mojang
online-mode.description: Only players with a real Minecraft account can join. Turn it off only behind a proxy that checks them.

allow-flight.title: Allow flight
allow-flight.description: Players flying in survival, through a mod or a client, aren't kicked.

allow-nether.title: The Nether
allow-nether.description: Players can travel to the Nether.

spawn-protection.title: Spawn protection
spawn-protection.description: The radius around spawn, in blocks, that only operators can build in. 0 turns it off.

view-distance.title: View distance
view-distance.description: How many chunks around each player the server sends, as a radius.

simulation-distance.title: Simulation distance
simulation-distance.description: How many chunks around each player keep running, as a radius.

level-seed.title: World seed
level-seed.description: The seed a new world is made from. Empty picks one at random. It changes nothing once the world exists.

level-type.title: World type
level-type.description: The kind of world a new world is made as. It changes nothing once the world exists.
